title: Subjective immortality under the simplified postulates

statements.text: Under the simplified postulates an observer always transitions into some next state, so it follows a never-ending process even when its body is destroyed in the world it seems to inhabit. Müller counts this a likely artifact of postulates that cannot treat forgetting.

sources.quote: the observer will follow a never-ending Markovian process
this conclusion is likely an artefact of the deficiency that Postulates 3.2 do not allow us to reason about memory erasure
